capabilities: display a fading background image slideshow
fetch random photos from Lorem Picsum
add local vault images or web URLs
adjust display duration, fade time, and pane/UI/tab opacity
toggle the slideshow via a command
extras: Images are loaded over the network when random mode or web URLs are used; a privacy section explains that vault images stay local and no telemetry is sent. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to show rotating background images with fade transitions behind the workspace.
summary: Background slideshow that fades images behind the editor panes, using vault files, web URLs, or random photos from Lorem Picsum.
